title: Been working on a small horror game, would love for some people to try it out
author: Ok-Pea-9284
selftext:
Let me know what you like and think could be done better, or what you enjoyed!

  
Game is around 50-60 percent done when it comes to how I envision it

  
Info about the game: You play as Varia Thompson. The military has put up a quarantine zone around an entire county. Varia's sister was there. You need to find her, and the truth behind what is really going on inside those fences.

  
You can download it here!

[https://asamitakafan.itch.io/they-spoke](https://asamitakafan.itch.io/they-spoke)
